beats.say: A page forgotten in the printer is the simplest leak. Anyone walking down the corridor can take it.
Before you send, check which printer is selected and whether secure print is on.
Secure print releases pages only when you tap your card or type a PIN at the printer.
Mail from the scanner needs care too. Attackers often send phishing dressed up as a scanned document.

scenes.title: Printing day
scenes.intro: Today you are printing several documents. Look at the windows that open and decide.

actions.label: Send with secure print
actions.feedback: Correct. The document waits in the queue and comes out only when you are at the printer.

actions.label: Print directly
actions.feedback: The page will sit in the shared corridor waiting for you. If you are delayed, someone else may see it.

body.text: Business_trip_list.pdf is queued. It will print as soon as paper is loaded.

actions.label: Cancel print
actions.feedback: Correct. Once paper is loaded the page would come out without you, so resend it with secure print.

actions.label: Dismiss
actions.feedback: Whoever loads the paper will also pick up the list. Cancel the job still in the queue.

body.text: Download Drayver Yeniləyici to keep printing.

steps.say: A website offers you printer software.

actions.label: Download now
actions.feedback: A website cannot check the driver on your computer. Downloads like this are usually malware.

actions.label: Close
actions.feedback: Correct. Only technical support installs printer drivers.

actions.label: Report to technical support
actions.feedback: Excellent. Technical support will check where this window came from.

steps.label: Shared folder: Scans
steps.say: The passport copies you scanned landed in a shared folder.

actions.label: Move to my folder
actions.feedback: Correct. Move the file to your own folder so it does not stay in the shared one.

actions.label: Leave it there
actions.feedback: The whole floor can open this folder. Passport copies are personal data.

actions.label: Send the link to the department
actions.feedback: Personal data goes only to the person who needs it. Do not send it to the whole department.

scenes.prompt: Find the suspicious parts of this mail that claims to come from the scanner.

body.text: A document was scanned for you.
If you do not view it within 24 hours it will be deleted.

spots.label: Sender domain
spots.explain: Your scanner sends from idare.example. This domain looks similar but is different.

spots.label: Time pressure
spots.explain: A scanner does not rush you. Time pressure is a classic phishing sign.

spots.label: Outside link
spots.explain: The link leads to a site outside your organisation, where a password will be asked for.

spots.label: File extension
spots.explain: An .html file is a web page, not a document. Opening it can show a fake sign-in form.

question.prompt: You find someone else's salary table in the printer. What do you do?

options.label: Give it, unread, to the owner or a manager
options.feedback: Correct. The document goes back to the right hands, and the owner will be more careful next time.

options.label: Leave it, the owner will come
options.feedback: Everyone who comes after you can see it. Do not leave pages in the printer.

options.label: Throw it in the nearest bin
options.feedback: A page in an ordinary bin is easy to pick out. Confidential paper goes to the shredder.

options.label: Post a photo to the team chat: whose is this?
options.feedback: That spreads salary data to even more people. Quietly hand the page to its owner.

scenes.explain: A page left in the printer is a leak. Return it to the owner, or to a manager if the owner is unknown.

scenes.prompt: Match each situation with the right move.

pairs.left: Scan landed in a shared folder
pairs.right: Move it to your own folder

pairs.left: You must print a confidential file

scenes.explain: Small habits stop leaks while printing.

points: Send confidential files with secure print and collect them at once.
Only technical support installs printer software.
In scanner mail, check the sender and the file extension.
